title: MIA MVP v1 device access (ADR-0016, M70)
description: Cloud by default; device reads and actions only on request, with consent on the target device. Policy allow | ask | deny over (capability, requester, target, scope). A request from the target device itself (its app, or the app's WebView whose web session is bound to the device) is allowed; any other client gets an approval that only the target device may decide (Approval.device_consent), the run waits up to 120 s (waiting_for_device) and fails with a clear error on denial, timeout or an unreachable phone. Root document is a DeviceConsent.

deviceCapability.description: Known: contacts.read (device.contacts.search), alarm.clock (device.alarm.set), apps.open (device.app.open), telegram.draft (telegram.handoff). An unknown device tool is its own capability (its tool name) with kind external

capabilityKind.description: read = device data; action = affects only the user (may be pre-allowed); external = effect on other people (asked per action, never persistent)

kind.description: device_app = Mia app on a device; device_webview = the app's WebView (same device); web = a browser session; job/app are never offered device tools

label.description: Russian, for «<label> просит …», e.g. «браузер Chrome на macOS», «Mia на телефоне «Galaxy S25»»

DeviceConsent.description: Approval.device_consent: the approval can be decided only by the app on target_device_id (POST /v1/approvals/{id}/decision, bearer of a session on that device; others get 403 approval_device_only). Clients other than the target show «Подтвердите на телефоне» instead of approve/deny buttons

model_sees.description: What the model will receive, shown in the consent text (data minimization, ADR-0016 §6)

scopes.description: Scopes the device may choose: run (this request: the rest of the run, not for external acts) and, when allowed, persistent (this requester, 30 days)

DeviceGrant.description: A persistent permission given on this device to one requester (this browser session or that device). Ends at expires_at (30 days), on revocation, or when the requester's web session ends

DeviceAccessLogEntry.description: One request of another client for this device (ADR-0016 §10). Never contains the device's result

decision.description: pending/approved/denied/expired = asked on the device; allowed = by a run or persistent grant; blocked = turned off for other clients; offline = phone not reachable

remote.description: Other clients may ask for consent (default) or never use it; the device's own requests are not affected

DeviceToolCallList.description: GET /v1/devices/{device_id}/tool-calls: calls queued for this device by push delivery (a run from another client or from the app's WebView). The device executes each and posts POST /v1/runs/{run_id}/device-tool-results; it must skip a call_id it already runs from its own run stream

DevicePushConsent.description: FCM data-only message (high priority, TTL = time left) to the target device. The app shows a notification with actions «Разрешить» (decision approve, scope run) and «Отклонить» (deny), and the consent sheet on tap. All values are strings

DevicePushToolCall.description: FCM data-only wake-up (TTL 60 s): a call is queued for this device; fetch GET /v1/devices/{device_id}/tool-calls. Arguments never travel through FCM

ManifestDeviceCapability.description: plugin-manifest requires.deviceCapabilities item (for M72 «Где работает» and the consent screen)

description.description: User-facing, e.g. «По вашей просьбе ставит будильник ещё и в «Часах» телефона»

optional.description: The plugin works in the cloud without it (ADR-0016 §1)
